title: Fix Stale Closure in Interval Callback
concept: Functional State Updates vs Snapshot Closure
problemStatement: In React, `setCount(count + 1)` inside a `setInterval` with an empty dependency array always sees `count = 0`. Implement `createSafeCounter(initialValue)` that uses functional updater semantics `setCount(prev => prev + 1)` so that repeated ticks always compute against the freshest state.
interviewTrap: Writing `state = state + 1` or capturing `state` at closure creation time. Passing an updater function `prev => prev + 1` resolves the current value at invocation time.
